title: Dragon’s Family
paragraphs: “Won’t he get angry?”
“That depends.”

“Well, even if Ren gets angry, he’s not scary at all. Very well, I’ll explain. The assistant was an adopted child raised by a wild dragon. Because Ren killed the parent dragon, the child ended up suffering.”
“Well, I guess that can’t be helped…”
“So, there’s definitely a reason to hold a grudge.”
“I didn’t do that in this world!”
“And spreading the plague?”
“The plague spread because Ren left the corpse of the parent dragon unattended. You should remember this from your game knowledge, shouldn’t you?”
Ren averted his gaze and began thinking deeply at my question. If he acted according to his game knowledge, this would naturally happen. It seems he has an idea of what I’m talking about.
“…Yeah, I remember. It was a convenient quest with good drops.”
“A tragedy caused by blindly following game knowledge. Do you realize how much that dragon’s family suffered?”
“Ugh…”
“But worrying about it now won’t change anything. If we think about it, even we are probably hated so much by the Three Hero Church and Takt’s faction that killing us wouldn’t satisfy their grudge.”
Itsuki nodded at Father’s words. Well, when he puts it like that, I suppose that’s true. That said, my hatred for Takt’s faction is so deep that it doesn’t really change how I feel.
“Well, if Ren took responsibility and protected the assistant, then isn’t that fine?”
“When I told the Ren from two loops ago about it, he said he should have killed the child too.”
Father and Itsuki instantly took a step away from Ren.
“…I thought you were cool, but you’re actually cold-blooded.”
“That’s beyond redemption. He probably said that out of spite after being beaten down during a revenge fight or something. There might’ve even been murderous intent behind it.”
“Th-that’s not true! Motoyasu!”
Ah, he’s mad after all. But I have to say, Father is amazing. He spoke as if he had witnessed everything firsthand, and he was spot on. It shows just how well he understands this version of Ren.
“And, just like that, I explained this last time and made him angry. Though, for the record, he didn’t do any of that in the previous loop.”
“Yeah, that makes sense.”
“So, doesn’t that mean Ren is pretty much free now?”
“In the previous loop, his relationship with the assistant was just neutral, neither good nor bad.”
“Ren, keep getting along with Kuro-chan and Keel-kun, okay?”
“Don’t decide that for me!”
Ren let out a deep sigh.
“By the way, isn’t this about the time to start recruiting the rival’s parents?”
“Is something going on?”
“Unfortunately, yes.”
I explained to Father and the others about the class-up breakthrough and what was needed to achieve it. Since it’s something we’ll need for the upcoming battles, it’s necessary to talk about it.
“So basically, to make Raphtalia-chan and everyone else stronger, we need to extract information from the core stone of Takt’s dragon that Motoyasu gathered?”
“That’s right.”
“In the game, this would’ve been something you unlock after completing a quest, but in this world, we have to go through all these extra steps.”
“That’s how it is. But if that’s the case, I wish you had told us a little sooner…”
Father explained to the objecting Itsuki.
“Look, it’s Motoyasu, who loves Filolials. Since Filolials and dragons don’t get along, he probably didn’t want to talk about it as much as possible.”
“Even so…”
“Either way, now that we know this information, there’s only one thing to do.”
Ren nodded at my words. That’s right. I gave my spear a sharp click.
“Dragon parent slaying?”
“No! Naofumi, you know that’s not what I meant.”
“Sorry, sorry. Bad joke.”
“We’re not sure if we can reason with them, but we have something to offer. And if push comes to shove, we can restrain them and explain the situation. It’s not a bad deal for them either.”
“Exactly.”
This time, I need to make the best choice to avoid creating another rival like that second one.
I must protect Father’s chastity!
“Shall we get going then?”
“Indeed.”
“Since they don’t get along with Filolials, it’s probably best to leave them behind to avoid unnecessary complications.”
“But walking all the way would be a hassle.”
“Unfortunately, we don’t have a portal.”
“Flying would be overkill, so maybe we can get a ride part of the way.”
And with that, we had a plan. We quickly prepared for departure. We took a carriage and headed toward the eastern village.
“Where are you going?”
“Ah, are the heroes heading somewhere?”
“Oh my, you’re all so busy.”
Leading the way, Kou arrived, followed by big sister, her friend, and her big sister.
“Bwe?”
Ah, of course, the stalker pig was with them too. It looks like she’ll be sticking with Itsuki for a while.
“Yeah. We’re going to negotiate with someone a little unusual to ask them to join us. If it works out, everyone will be able to get even stronger.”
“Oh my… I think everyone’s already strong enough, but is that still not enough?”
“It seems that way. The battles ahead are only going to get tougher. That’s why… I want everyone to become stronger.”
At Father’s words, big sister’s big sister looked at the others and smiled. It seems she understood.
“Right. Naofumi-chan, will you all be okay by yourselves?”
“Um, I want to go too!”
Big sister’s friend raised her hand.
“Huh? You want to go?”
“Yes. Is it a dangerous opponent?”
“I wonder… According to Motoyasu, it doesn’t seem that dangerous, but…”
“Then I want to go. Right, Rifana-chan?”
“U-uhm, yes.”
Big sister also nodded.
But… is it necessary to bring them along for negotiations with the rival’s parent?
“Oh my?”
“Naofumi-san, are you taking them along?”
“Hmm…”
“They probably won’t be a burden, but it could be extra trouble.”
“What should we do? Should they stay behind in the eastern village with the Filolials?”

“The opponent has a child, even if it’s an adopted one, right? In that case, bringing kids along might make it easier to gain their trust… but I don’t like the idea of using Rifana and the others like that…”
“We’ll be fine!”
Big sister’s friend declared confidently.
“If we can be of help, we want to do our best.”
“Y-yeah! If there’s someone we can get along with, I’d like to meet them.”

It seems big sister agreed with her friend’s opinion. Hmm, now that I think about it, in the first world, big sister got along well with Filo-tan and maintained a fairly good relationship with the rival. Bringing them along might turn things in our favor.
“Oh my, then maybe big sister should come along to protect these two.”
“Bwe?”
“Umm, Rishia-san, it’s dangerous, so please stay and watch the village.”
Itsuki instructed the stalker pig, who was about to follow, to stay behind.
“You still need more training before you can become a true hero who fights the Waves.”
“Bwu!”
The stalker pig, seemingly inspired by Itsuki’s words, nodded energetically. Honestly, such a troublesome one.
“Absolutely no reckless actions, okay? And stay behind me as much as possible.”
“Okay!”
Big sister’s friend raised her hand in agreement.
“I’m sure the others would want to come too, but let’s go with first come, first served… Alright, shall we go?”
“Understood!”
And so, with big sister and the others in tow, we headed toward the eastern village.
“Sakura-chan, Kou, and Yuki-chan, wait for us in the eastern village, okay? If you come along, things will definitely get messy.”
Right now, Father is convincing Sakura-chan and the others. I’m sure he’ll manage to persuade them.
